Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000402" [constraint]: The billing service ships only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC.  (about: billing service)
- memory_id "1000387": Dashboards and alerts for the resizer are being repointed as of 2025-04-29.  (about: resizer)
- memory_id "1000372": On 2025-04-26, the ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour during INC-2025-011.  (about: ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000368": On 2025-04-18, Team Atlas reported that the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change.  (about: Team Atlas, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000365" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the ledger deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger)
- memory_id "1000330" [decision]: As of 2025-04-07, Priya carries the Team Atlas pager until the next rotation.  (about: Team Atlas, Priya)
- memory_id "1000324" [decision]: On 2025-04-04, Team Dune agreed that the catalog service will keep image metadata in a separate table.  (about: Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000268": As of 2025-03-24, Farah still has the Team Dune pager.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000266" [constraint]: The catalog service ships only on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000259": Team Dune owns the catalog service as of the 2025-03-20 ownership transfer.  (about: Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000255": As of 2025-03-20, the pager for the catalog service rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000244" [constraint]: The scheduler deploys on weekdays after 15:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: scheduler)
- memory_id "1000241" [constraint]: The webhooks service ships only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000201": Team Cinder holds planning on Mondays.  (about: Team Cinder)
- memory_id "1000186" [constraint]: The reporting service may be released only on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC, and any other release time requires an exception.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000183" [constraint]: The event bus deploys on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: event bus)
- memory_id "1000178": Team Cinder observed that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade, and flagged it since it is not their service.  (about: Team Cinder, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000174": On 2025-02-21, Yuki handed the Team Cinder pager to Diego during rotation day.  (about: Team Cinder, Yuki, Diego)
- memory_id "1000147" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the auth gateway deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.  (about: auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000098": Farah takes the first on-call rotation for Team Dune.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
